title: Of the Laws of Ecclesiastical Polity
author: Richard Hooker
source_edition: John Keble, ed., The Works of Richard Hooker, Oxford University Press, 1836, vols. 1-3. Internet Archive DjVuTXT scans.
notes: Parser strategy: extend gutenberg_systematics.py rather than fork. Hooker matches the existing multi-volume structured_text parser shape; its extra Keble apparatus is handled by work-specific book ranges and cleanup. The plain-text OCR does not expose stable chapter title lines, so numbered Roman divisions and running-header chapter signals are normalised into chapter nodes. Keble editorial footnotes and marginal notes remain inline where OCR interleaves them; sermons and the tractate on Justification are outside this Polity-only output. Plain-text inline emphasis markers are stripped in the JSON projection; bare numeric note anchors are tagged as [[pg-note-anchor:N]].
